title: Plan 22: implement refill history, reorder estimates and notices
body:
Plan: [Plan 22](https://github.com/datagen24/victual/blob/master/docs/plans/22-medication-tracking.md). Scope decisions: PR #692. Target: milestone 0.5.0.

Implement private refill tracking and the agreed notice behavior. Keep reorder eligibility estimates distinct from inventory balances and consumption.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Persist fill history, supplied duration, medication-specific rules and explicit dates using the agreed precedence and correction semantics.
- [ ] Implement the approximate 14-days-remaining fallback only when no specific rule applies; show unknown for missing inputs and the provenance of every calculated date.
- [ ] Provide approaching/due and ordered/received behavior, configurable warning lead, repeat suppression and client-readable dates/state according to the design.
- [ ] Organizer transfers, consumption and merely placing an order do not reset fill history or add stock.
- [ ] Private refill routes, UI and notification payloads honor scoped access and revocation.
- [ ] Deliver API/OpenAPI, contract snapshots, UI/translations and operator documentation. Native platform notice delivery stays in victual-kit.
- [ ] Tests cover 30-/90-day fills, specific-rule overrides, explicit dates, invalid inputs, calendar boundaries, corrections, deduplication and receipt.

Do not describe fallback dates as confirmed insurance eligibility or add dose schedules to obtain them.

## Dependencies

Complete the applicable design decisions and predecessor work before the dependent implementation.
